neighbours.label: How widely a product or work is bought, sold, licensed or taken up (its market reach)
fire: Her memoir came out last spring and the movie rights have already gone to a streaming service.
Since launch the puzzle app has sold over six million copies worldwide.
Advertisers now rely on social channels to promote and sell their products.
The single got a huge amount of airplay and climbed the charts in a dozen countries.
By Christmas, families had bought the toy in such numbers that shops ran out.
Fans have downloaded the free update nearly two million times.
The handheld sold hundreds of thousands of units within weeks of going on sale.
The card game is now enjoyed by millions of players across the globe.
quiet: Her memoir describes a childhood on a sheep farm in the hills above the lake.
Since noon the puzzle has sat unfinished on the table by the window.
Neighbours now rely on the old well to water their gardens in summer.
The single lamp gave a dim light and flickered over a dozen wooden chairs.
By Christmas, the family had painted the kitchen and fixed the broken gate.
Workers have repaired the free ferry after a long winter in the dry dock.
The handheld radio has a short antenna and a dial on one side.
The card table is made of oak with green felt across the top.

notes: The nouns on the card (rights, copies, channels, downloads) share one pattern: the commercial spread of a product. Tested on new products; 'civil rights' stayed quiet in probing.
